incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty alert AUTO-PAGE fired for synth/canary-checks/canary-v1 (apac). Condition: consecutive failures >= 3 across probes. PD incident INC-2141 created.
PagerDuty: Incident INC-2141 assigned to schedule: oncall-rotation.
Nate R: acking in PD, grabbing context. Oncall here.
Nate R: quick check — are these HTTP 5xx or timeouts?
incident-bot: failures are 502 and connection timeout (curl exit 28). Sample probe logs attached.
Maya L: seeing similar in Grafana: increased 5xx rate for inference-router-apac pool starting ~00:08UTC.
Sara K: tagging potential customer impact: a handful of requests from apac customers failing to complete, routing fallback used for hosted-tier. No bulk outage reported yet.
Elaine R: confirmed alerts from synthetic: path /v1/health returning 502, trace id header absent.
Nate R: running quick probe from my laptop:```bash
curl -v -H "Host: canary.redwood-inference.internal" "https://apac-probe.redwood-infra/v1/health" -w "%{http_code}\n" -o /dev/null
```
Nate R: result: timeout after 30s (exit 28).
Maya L: k8s metrics show cpu of inference-router-apac nodes spiked 3x at 00:07. Pod restarts around same time. Could be rolling update artifact.
Sara K: checking deployment history — no normal deploys scheduled. But autoscaler did trigger scale-up.
Nate R: fetching recent events:```bash
kubectl -n prod get events --field-selector involvedObject.kind=Deployment,involvedObject.name=inference-router-apac --sort-by=.lastTimestamp | tail -n 20
```
Nate R: seeing repeated `FailedScheduling` then `BackOff` on some pods.
incident-bot: PagerDuty note appended: 'oncall investigating synth failures; scaling/backoff observed'.
Maya L: trying quick mitigation: reducing per-pod worker threads via deploy override (will keep running for 10m). If that removes pressure, we can revert config later.
Elaine R: also enabling prefix cache bypass for canary traffic to reduce per-request CPU.
Nate R: applying k8s rollout patch:```bash
kubectl -n prod set env deploy/inference-router-apac WORKER_THREADS=4 --record
kubectl -n prod rollout restart deploy/inference-router-apac
```
Nate R: rollout started. ETA ~45s per pod.
Sara K: notifying SRE on-call to watch for pod crashloops. @oncall-rotation please monitor.
oncall-rotation: watching. tailing logs.
Maya L: probe re-run after first pod restart: 502 -> 200. :white_check_mark: one success out of three.
Nate R: looks promising. continuing rollout.
incident-bot: PD INC-2141 status: acknowledged by Nate R.
PagerDuty: Escalation timer paused by ack.
Elaine R: after full rollout, synth success rate climbed to 98% over 5m window. Error budget hit reduced.
Sara K: customer impact summary for handoff: intermittent 5xx/timeouts for APAC canary traffic between 00:07-00:18UTC, affecting small % of requests. No sustained data loss. Mitigations: reduced WORKER_THREADS, prefix cache bypass, pod restarts. Root cause hypothesis: autoscaler + transient scheduling pressure causing overloaded pods (investigating node maintenance and k8s events).
Maya L: creating follow-up ticket INFRA-872 to track node pressure metrics and autoscaler config. Assign to eng-infra.
Nate R: adding timeline to PD and posting summary to #incidents.
Nate R: handing off to Sara K for next shift. Sara — please continue monitoring and post final incident note when resolved.
Sara K: acked, taking over. Short summary for next oncall: probe failures triggered PD, mitigated by worker thread reduction and restarts. Watch for node-level pressure and correlated maintenance.
Elaine R: quick note — pushed temporary alert tweak to increase canary probe tolerance to avoid noisy paging while we tune autoscaler. Will revert after postmortem.
incident-bot: PD INC-2141 note: status changed to 'monitoring' (no longer firing).
PagerDuty: INC-2141 updated: assigned to Sara K.
Sara K: leaving final WA note: monitoring stable, synth success > 99% for 15m. Will open follow-up postmortem in product for RCA and mitigation actions. :hourglass_flowing_sand:
Nate R: :thumbsup: good handoff.
Maya L: :eyes: will pick up infra ticket tomorrow morning.
Sara K: closing PD for now but keeping as follow-up.
incident-bot: This thread will remain open for 24h auto-archive.
